body: Personal note — the early shift: wash off the blue powder left by the fertilizer test crew. the dog refused its water, and I had not yet heard that the buses quit running.
title: the early shift — blue powder
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same blue powder while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.

body:
We wrote names on the wall when the guest book disappeared. It was a joke until a visitor asked us to paint over them.

One friend had gone for more drinks and was not there to object. By morning somebody had covered only his name. The rest remained visible through the paint.

I took a photograph before anyone did the second coat. I cannot tell if he came back while we were asleep.
title: Someone took the guest book
gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
